title: Cursor/pr5427 hold head receipt b562
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Audit of one existing intake receipt. No new κ, no selected-frontier change, and no closure.

On canonical main `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`, the queue-oct24a snapshot’s four `waiting_revision` rows are still open and unretained:

| PR | Recorded head | On this base |
|---|---|---|
| #4580 | `55de56abdfd9cd7fb83758241793c18b9ae9ce71` | not installed |
| #4612 | `0e0df631da41a1f9ed3489e8df532189c2643cbf` | not installed |
| #5427 | `389578f2d3ef075495ce76f08100ac50e18f7d40` | not installed |
| #5432 | `6532b45ce9f3259d7408594ec480a140ec81e0e2` | not installed |

#5427’s ledger text is still Clear1nsight’s Part 1 qualification of that modular head (`A=[p]`, `b=1`), with Part 2 not independently accepted.

The live #5427 head observed on 2026-10-25 is `e0192de5d97e5ac09f42d26d9ceedee6377c77e2`. Its parents are the exact-Q repair `dacc35b1f35c2b4bc2e3910520ba5cf46a020bed` (child of `389578f2`) and this base. The repair is not contained in the base. The other three recorded heads still matched GitHub on that observation.

One replay of Matarener’s checker at `e0192de5` on CPython 3.12.3 exited 0 with `PASS_ZQY_OBSERVATION_NOT_RETAINED`. That is an author-checker replay, not acceptance of Part 2.

An ours-merge makes `389578f2` and `dacc35b1f` reachable so the source pins resolve. It does not take the ZQY tree. The file diff is the receipt package only.

## Task and overlap

Task `overlap-receipt`, scope refined to this one receipt. Base `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`.

Nearest work is the maintained queue-oct24a receipt and Clear1nsight’s review of `389578f2`. This package records that the hold does not name `dacc35b1f`. Distinct from the eight-frontier-source retention receipt.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B research/pr5427-hold-head-receipt/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr5427-hold-head-receipt
```

Both passed (`PASS_PR5427_HOLD_HEAD_RECEIPT`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`).

## Credit

Queue-oct24a and the ledger rows are the maintained record. Chris R / Clear1nsight wrote the Part 1 qualification. Mark / Matarener wrote the ZQY package and the exact-Q repair. The package scaffold is Douglas Colkitt’s.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Re-read #5427 at `e0192de5` before any closure. The modular sentence no longer matches that head. Part 2 remains outside the earlier review. This receipt does not perform that reading.
